results.title: This Very Second
results.overview: After losing his partner, astronomer Wang Ren, Nuqiu takes a job as a janitor at the astronomical institute where Wang once worked. There he meets Lin, Wang's former colleague. As the two grow closer, an unseen force quietly pulls them together, like gravity.

results.title: I Knead You
results.overview: A heartbroken baker creates a life-sized bread lover with some mysterious flour, sparking a twisted love triangle that spirals into obsession, horror, and survival.

results.title: Unleashed Spirits: The Rise of the Hollywood Vampires
results.original_title: Unleashed Spirits: The Rise of the Hollywood Vampires
results.overview: A documentary explores the formation and journey of the rock supergroup, the Hollywood Vampires.

results.title: Bagel GO
results.overview: To Ming, Yuhe sparkled brighter than anyone. She was certain Yuhe would win the Bagel Idol Selection and fulfill her dream. As for Ming, she dreamed of becoming Hero Bagel, a hero to save the world. Whenever Yuhe needed help, she could leap in and declare: “Here comes the hero!”

results.title: Harrison Ford Comes to Wichita
results.overview: When Hollywood legend Harrison Ford makes his annual trips to Wichita, KS, the town buzzes with local folklore known as “Harrison Sightings."  For filmmaker Graham High, what begins as an investigation into a hometown mystery unfolds into something bigger. Harrison Ford Comes to Wichita is a feature-length documentary that explores an endearing American city, its unassuming locals, and the unexpected ways we find ourselves in the places we left behind.

results.title: The Ghost of Piñera
results.overview: Bastián receives a visit from his friend Franco, who gives him a peculiar gift: a pellet gun.  That day, the former president of Chile dies and begins to appear to Bastián in the form of a Cloth Ghost.  All of this occurs amidst the rise to power of the far right in Chile.

results.title: Jesaja
results.overview: The fifth year of the New Normal begins in 2024. Finland prepares for war. In Helsinki, Jesaja Jalonen, a remote digital worker, prepares for the run of his life.

results.title: When Wine Meets Coffee
results.overview: When Claire, a sophisticated wine expert, travels to Costa Rica, her carefully ordered world collides with Alex, a passionate coffee producer deeply rooted in his family’s land. As wine and coffee, past and present, begin to intertwine, an unexpected connection challenges what they thought they knew about love, memory, and the paths that bring people together.

results.title: The story of James Howells
results.overview: Inspired by real events, this video tells the story of a Welsh computer engineer who, twelve years ago, accidentally threw away a hard drive containing the private key to 8 000 Bitcoins (worth nearly a billion dollars today). Since then, he has been trying by all possible means to recover it. The video takes the form of a wandering journey through Newport between the depths of a landfill and the depths of the internet, where thoughts and trash overlap.

results.title: My Dinner With Victor
results.overview: Two childhood friends meet after a long absence, but a cultural mix-up leads to hilarious – and deadly – consequences.

results.title: As Far Back As I Can Remember... The Story of Goodfellas
results.original_title: As Far Back As I Can Remember... The Story of Goodfellas
results.overview: The ultimate love letter to Martin Scorsese's classic film GoodFellas (1990).

results.title: Words in the Wind
results.overview: Inspired by the Yunnanese concept of chit-chatting, the film gently moves through the everyday lives of Yunnanese women navigating the northern Thai-Myanmar border. From doorsteps to coffee shops, the camera lingers to capture fragments of memories, histories of flight, and the echoes of lives shaped by conflict.

results.title: Kumarangk: Sacred Women's Business
results.overview: A bridge divided a state. The Ngarrindjeri women at its heart reclaim their story.

results.title: The Bloopers and Deleted Scenes of Symbiotica
results.original_title: The Bloopers and Deleted Scenes of Symbiotica
results.overview: Everything you don't get to see in the final cut of Symbiotica (2026).

results.title: The Visitor
results.overview: After receiving a strange phone call late at night, a young man is visited by a mysterious stranger who claims to know something that he has forgotten.

results.title: Also Fine
results.overview: Used to keeping quiet, Wei shuts out his parents' absurd antics behind closed doors. Neglected at home, Hsuan travels north by herself and stumbles into Wei's life. Taipei's starry nights, planes piercing the sky... these overlooked everyday moments in the city turn into a ray of light for them against an ambiguous future.

results.title: Ruby, Ruby
results.overview: When they awaken a deadly curse, two young women, Ollie and Hannah, find themselves trapped in a haunted cemetery with a malicious predator, thrusting them into a nightmarish battle for survival against evils, both supernatural and human.

results.title: Snow Leopard
results.overview: When his older sister Samantha leaves their small Colorado town for college, sixteen-year-old Owen is left behind with a silence he doesn't know how to fill. With Samantha hundreds of miles away, Owen finds himself drifting through empty rooms and long, quiet days as the distance between them slowly reshapes his world.
